content.title: Siemens 391-2478 Servo Drive - EtherCAT, 9 A Rated Output Current
content.short_description: Siemens 391-2478 is a servo drive with EtherCAT communication and a rated output current of 9 A.
content.long_description:
The Siemens 391-2478 is a servo drive designed for closed-loop servo control applications. It uses the servo control method to regulate motor position, speed, and torque, and communicates via EtherCAT for integration into networked motion control systems.

Rated output current for this unit is 9 A, which should be matched against the connected servo motor's current requirements during system specification. As a Device Type classified as a Servo Drive, it is intended for use within drives and controls setups in industrial electrical systems.

When specifying the 391-2478, confirm the EtherCAT network configuration and controller compatibility, and verify the 9 A rated output current aligns with the load and motor requirements of the application.
